remarks: The best luxury residence building on the hill, "The Buckingham" offers the most outstanding convenient location to our vibrant down town, with a concierge on the premises, security 24 hr doorman service, 2 deeded parking spaces in the gated garage with storage, lovely in-ground heated pool, a gym w/sauna, and a full service community/party room with kitchen & big screen TV. Also, a library, conference room, and patio terrance making community living social and fun. This penthouse unit with impressive westerly views, has an outdoor balcony that's spacious for relaxing time. A full wall of storage closets for all your belongings which make easy access a dream. Pristine hardwood floors, freshly painted interiors creating a clean palette to decorate the amazing living spaces. This very special prestigious building is welcoming to impress your guests and family with pride and to enjoy this fine lifestyle as your home.
